title: Blu Track PS - 18 ft. Stunt Set

reviews.title: Best track ever
reviews.body: The best track ever. I love that I can roll it up and bring it with us anywhere. It's not bulky to store unlike many other car tracks. My kids like making there own tracks and finding new ways to put it around the house.
reviews.author: Madison

reviews.title: Compact storage and creative fun
reviews.body: The blue track is simple yet fun. It rolls up to a smallish size which makes for easy storage. The ramos are fun for making loops and jumps. The cars that come with the track aren’t the most durable in the wheels, but they are fast. This track works great with hot wheels size cars. You can also run large monster truck size vehicles down it by using both lanes, one for each side of tires. It’s more compact than a lot of the hot wheels sets which is why I bought it. It does involve more creativity for the kids, and they have set up some fun courses using chairs and other pieces of furniture.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 20 July 2026
reviews.author: Cristina

reviews.title: Super fun! but brittle:(
reviews.body: This is the funniest track for kids.  I bought it about 7 months ago for my preschool.  It's been the favorite toy of both the boys and girls.  The reason I gave it 3 stars is because it is braking.  We don't even use the loops.  I don't know if I missed the note on  how to care for it. But, for as expensive as it was, I think it should have lasted a bit better. I am always around when the kids are playing with it, so it has not been because of absence.  It's super, I just wish it was not cracking. It stops the cars from going down the track.Update: I emailed Blu track and Amy got right back with me. She had me send her the below pictures and again, very prompt she got back with me is sending me a new track. I really would recommend this wonderful fun track from such a great customer focused company!!!! Thank you Blu Track and Amy
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 25 March 2025
reviews.author: TDR

reviews.title: Fun but not sturdy
reviews.body: It's a very fun toy and my 5yo loves it, but the the ramp support pieces do not stay in place, they slide off very easily from the track and are made of very thin lightweight plastic.I wish they were sturdier, grabbing the track more firmly, and heavier. Light as they are, they move out of place whenever the cars pass through.The stabilizer sticks are nearly impossible to slide in, even for me to do it.
reviews.author: Thalita Dol

reviews.title: a hit with our 3 year old
reviews.body: Great for my 3 year old to just set one end up on a chair and zoom his cars down. As he gets older he can do more with it.
reviews.author: Murray D
